decisions.reason: Because this recruitment service is distant from the firm’s maritime core and shows no visible performance signal beyond continued mention, it is likely falling short of aspiration relative to stronger core opportunities and its resources are better redeployed.

This service builds directly on the firm’s established crewing capabilities, and in a growing firm with some slack the continued market presence supports keeping it while learning about demand in this adjacent niche.

The programme quickly built a six-institution partner network after launch, which is a clear early result above a reasonable aspiration for a new education offering closely tied to the firm’s skills and training assets.

Successfully transferring all required Monitoring Plans before the FuelEU deadline indicates strong performance against customer and regulatory aspirations, so this compliance service should be retained and expanded.

The dashboard fits the firm’s digitalisation and environmental strategy and is integrated into its core ship-management software, so organisational slack and strategic complementarity justify keeping it despite limited stand-alone results so far.

The cost simulation tool is closely related to the new emissions compliance offer and embedded in existing software, making it a sensible product to keep while the firm learns from customer uptake and cross-selling potential.
